title: 第十三章 灵珠无光仍是凡第十四章 暗流涌动楚家院
content_zh:
“拿下这弑亲叛逆的孽障！死活不论！”
大长老楚山那饱含杀意和家主威压的冰冷宣判，如同丧钟在死寂的祠堂广场上敲响！声音里再无半分惊疑和探寻，只剩下被彻底愚弄的滔天怒火和清理门户的冷酷决心！测灵珠那死水般的沉寂，如同最响亮的耳光，狠狠抽在他脸上！废骨！依旧是废骨！那官道上的凶威，果然是邪魔外道的诡术！
数名气息最为冷厉、眼神如同毒蛇的执法队精锐，早已蓄势待发！听到命令的瞬间，眼中凶光爆射！他们如同训练有素的猎犬，没有丝毫犹豫！手中那缠绕着森然寒气、淬着幽蓝剧毒的铁链，如同出洞的毒蟒，带着刺耳的破空声，撕裂空气，瞬间缠绕向楚夜的四肢和脖颈！另一人则手持狭长的淬毒钢刀，刀锋闪烁着致命的幽光，如同毒蝎的尾刺，悄无声息地刺向楚夜的后心！配合默契，狠辣刁钻！这是要瞬间废掉楚夜所有行动力，再施以绝杀！
“夜儿——！！！”柳氏发出撕心裂肺的尖叫，不顾一切地想要扑上去！
然而，此刻的楚夜，却仿佛陷入了一种诡异的僵直！
他依旧保持着触碰测灵珠的姿势，指尖按在冰凉的珠体上。身体僵硬如石雕，脸色在阳光下呈现出一种极不正常的惨白！豆大的冷汗瞬间浸透了他额前的碎发，顺着苍白的脸颊滚滚而下！他的身体在无法控制地微微颤抖，牙关紧咬，牙龈甚至渗出了血丝！
不是恐惧执法队的攻击！而是——
识海深处，那片被无形天道枷锁捆缚的混沌虚空，正掀起灭世风暴！那双冰冷的、毫无感情的巨眼，如同高悬的审判之轮，死死锁定着他灵魂的核心！源自生命本源的、冰冷刺骨的恐惧和窒息感，如同亿万钧重的冰山，死死压在他的灵魂之上！后背脊骨深处的混沌道骨，发出尖锐而痛苦的哀鸣，如同被投入熔炉的星辰，疯狂地震颤着，试图挣脱那无形的、源自更高维度的恐怖束缚！
道骨内部那新生的、如同溪流般的混沌力量，在这至高天威的碾压下，如同沸水般剧烈冲突、暴走！一部分力量在道骨本能的驱使下，疯狂地冲击着识海中那道无形的枷锁虚影，试图撕裂这来自“天”的束缚！另一部分力量则不受控制地在楚夜体内横冲直撞，撕裂着刚刚重组的经脉，冲击着五脏六腑！剧痛如同亿万根钢针，瞬间淹没了他的神经！
更可怕的是！肩胛骨下方，那块被混沌灰芒击中的位置！那股被暂时压制的、阴冷污秽的诡异能量，仿佛受到了天道威压的“滋养”，如同被注入了狂暴的催化剂，瞬间疯狂地膨胀、爆发！它如同跗骨之蛆，顺着暴走的混沌力量，疯狂地侵蚀、污染着道骨的本源！所过之处，带来一种深入骨髓的、如同灵魂被玷污般的冰冷刺痛和强烈的滞涩感！仿佛要将那初生的混沌星辰彻底拖入污秽的深渊！
内外交困！天道枷锁的至高威压，混沌力量的暴走反噬，污秽能量的疯狂侵蚀！三重毁灭性的打击，如同三股狂暴的洪流，在楚夜体内轰然碰撞！将他死死钉在原地，动弹不得！只能眼睁睁看着那缠绕着死亡寒气的锁链和淬毒的钢刀，如同死神的镰刀，瞬息而至！
“完了…”柳氏眼中瞬间被绝望吞噬，身体软软地瘫倒下去。
“死！”执法队精锐脸上露出残忍的快意！
就在这千钧一发、楚夜即将被锁链缠身、钢刀贯体的刹那——
嗡！！！
一声只有楚夜灵魂能感知的、充满不屈与愤怒的恐怖嗡鸣，猛地从他识海深处炸响！那是混沌道骨在生死绝境和天道威压双重刺激下，爆发的最后、也是最强烈的反抗意志！
轰——！！！
楚夜体内那暴走冲突的混沌力量，竟被这股不屈的意志强行拧成了一股！不再冲击枷锁，不再与污秽纠缠，而是如同被压缩到极致的灭世雷霆，带着一种玉石俱焚、冲破一切的决绝意念，轰然爆发，涌向他僵硬的四肢百骸！
咔嚓！咔嚓！
楚夜身体周围的空间，仿佛承受不住这股源自混沌本源的狂暴力量冲击，发出细微的、如同镜面碎裂般的**！那无形的天道威压枷锁，竟被这不顾一切的爆发，硬生生撕开了一丝极其极其细微的缝隙！

就是这一丝缝隙！
让楚夜那被彻底冻结的意识，获得了一瞬间的清明！身体也恢复了极其短暂的行动力！
“吼——！！！”
一声压抑到极致、如同濒死凶兽般的咆哮从楚夜喉咙深处迸发！他双目瞬间赤红如血！身体以一种超越极限的、近乎扭曲的姿态猛地一震！
砰！砰！砰！
那缠绕向他四肢和脖颈的冰冷锁链，在接触到楚夜皮肤的瞬间，竟被他体内爆发的那股狂暴混沌力量硬生生震开！锁链上附带的剧毒幽蓝光芒如同遇到克星般瞬间黯淡！持链的执法队员只觉得一股难以抗拒的巨力顺着锁链传来，虎口崩裂，铁链脱手！身体踉跄后退！
与此同时！
楚夜的身体如同鬼魅般强行侧转！那柄刺向他后心的淬毒钢刀，贴着他的肋下险之又险地擦过！锋利的刀锋划破了他本就破烂的衣衫，在他坚韧的皮肤上留下了一道浅浅的血痕！剧毒幽光沾染伤口，带来一阵火辣辣的刺痛！
险死还生！
然而，这强行爆发挣脱天道枷锁束缚的代价，是毁灭性的！
噗——！！！
一大口混合着暗金色泽和丝丝污秽黑气的滚烫鲜血，如同喷泉般从楚夜口中狂喷而出！鲜血中甚至夹杂着细小的内脏碎片！他眼前瞬间被无边的黑暗和血色淹没！全身的骨骼发出密集的爆鸣，仿佛随时会再次碎裂！经脉如同被烈火焚烧，寸寸断裂！刚刚恢复的力量如同潮水般瞬间退去，只留下深入骨髓的剧痛和极致的虚弱！
content_en:
"Take down this evil obstacle of parricide and rebellion! No matter life or death!"
The great elder Chu Shan's cold verdict, full of murderous intent and the pressure of the family leader, was like a death knell ringing in the dead silence of the ancestral hall square! There was no trace of surprise or exploration in the voice, only the overwhelming anger of being completely fooled and the cold determination to clean up the family! The stagnant silence of the Lingzhu Pearl was like the loudest slap in the face, slapped hard on his face! Waste bones! Still a waste! The ferocious power in official circles is indeed the trick of evil heretics!
Several elite law enforcement teams with the coldest auras and eyes like poisonous snakes are already ready to attack! The moment he heard the order, a fierce light burst out in his eyes! They were like well-trained hunting dogs, without any hesitation! The iron chain in his hand, entwined with the cold air and quenched with blue poison, was like a poisonous python coming out of its hole. It tore the air with a harsh sound, and instantly wrapped around Chu Ye's limbs and neck! The other person was holding a long and narrow poison-quenched steel knife. The blade flashed with a deadly light, like the stinger of a poisonous scorpion, stabbing Chu Ye silently in the back of the heart! Cooperate with each other tacitly and be ruthless and cunning! This is to instantly eliminate all Chu Ye's mobility and then execute a decisive blow!
"Ye'er——!!!" Mrs. Liu let out a heartbreaking scream, desperately trying to pounce on her!
However, Chu Ye seemed to have fallen into a strange stiffness at this moment!
He still maintained the posture of touching the spirit-detecting bead, pressing his fingertips on the cold bead. His body was as stiff as a stone sculpture, and his face looked extremely pale in the sunlight! A heavy cold sweat instantly soaked the broken hair on his forehead and rolled down his pale cheeks! His body was shaking uncontrollably, his teeth were clenched, and blood even oozed from his gums!
Not afraid of attacks from the law enforcement team! But——
Deep in the sea of consciousness, the chaotic void bound by the invisible shackles of heaven is setting off a world-destroying storm! Those cold, emotionless giant eyes were like high-hanging wheels of judgment, locking tightly onto the core of his soul! The icy-cold fear and suffocation originating from the origin of life were like billions of icebergs, pressing firmly on his soul! The chaotic bones deep in the spine of the back let out a sharp and painful cry, like stars being thrown into a furnace, trembling crazily, trying to break free from the invisible and terrifying shackles originating from higher dimensions!
The new, stream-like chaotic power inside the Dao Bone, under the crushing force of the supreme power of God, clashed violently and ran wild like boiling water! Driven by the instinct of the Taoist body, part of the force frantically attacks the invisible shackles in the sea of ​​consciousness, trying to tear apart the shackles from "heaven"! The other part of the power was rushing through Chu Ye's body uncontrollably, tearing apart the newly reorganized meridians and impacting the internal organs! The severe pain was like billions of steel needles, instantly flooding his nerves!
What's even scarier! Below the shoulder blade, the spot hit by the gray light of chaos! The temporarily suppressed, cold and filthy weird energy seemed to be "nourished" by the pressure of heaven, as if it had been injected with a violent catalyst, and it expanded and exploded crazily in an instant! It is like a tarsal maggot, following the rampant power of chaos, crazily eroding and polluting the origin of the Tao bone! Wherever it passes, it brings a cold sting and a strong sense of stagnation that goes deep into the bone marrow, as if the soul has been tainted! It seemed as if it was going to drag the newly born chaotic stars into the abyss of filth!
Troubled internally and externally! The supreme pressure of the shackles of heaven, the violent backlash of the power of chaos, and the crazy erosion of filthy energy! Three devastating blows, like three violent torrents, collided in Chu Ye's body! Pin him to the spot, unable to move! I can only watch helplessly as the chains wrapped in the cold air of death and the poison-quenched steel knife arrive in an instant like the scythe of death!
"It's over..." Liu's eyes were instantly swallowed by despair, and her body collapsed softly.
"Death!" The face of the elite law enforcement team showed cruel joy!
Right thereAt this critical moment, when Chu Ye was about to be wrapped in chains and a steel sword penetrated his body——
Buzz! ! !
A terrifying buzz that only Chu Ye's soul could sense, full of unyielding and anger, suddenly exploded from the depths of his consciousness! That was the last and strongest will of resistance that the Chaos Dao Bones erupted under the dual stimulation of the desperate situation of life and death and the pressure of heaven!
boom--! ! !
The violent and conflicting chaotic forces in Chu Ye's body were forcibly twisted into one by this unyielding will! No longer attacking the shackles, no longer entangled with the filth, but like a world-destroying thunder compressed to the extreme, with a determination to destroy everything and break through everything, it exploded and surged towards his stiff limbs and bones!
Click! Click!
The space around Chu Ye's body seemed to be unable to withstand the impact of this violent force originating from the origin of chaos, and it emitted a tiny ** like a mirror shattering! The invisible shackles of heaven's pressure were torn open by this desperate explosion, an extremely tiny gap!
It's this little gap!
Let Chu Ye's completely frozen consciousness gain a moment of clarity! The body also regained its mobility for a very short period of time!
"Roar——!!!"
An extremely suppressed roar, like a dying beast, burst out from the depths of Chu Ye's throat! His eyes were instantly as red as blood! The body shook violently in an almost twisted posture that exceeded the limit!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The cold chains wrapped around his limbs and neck, the moment they came into contact with Chu Ye's skin, were violently shaken away by the violent chaotic power that erupted in his body! The poisonous blue light attached to the chain instantly dimmed as if encountering a nemesis! The law enforcement team member holding the chain felt an irresistible force coming down the chain. The tiger's mouth burst and the chain fell away! The body staggered back!
at the same time!
Chu Ye's body turned sideways forcefully like a ghost! The poison-quenched steel knife stabbed at his back, narrowly grazing against his ribs! The sharp blade cut through his already tattered clothes, leaving a shallow blood mark on his tough skin! The poisonous light contaminated the wound, causing a burning sting!
Survive the danger of death!
However, the cost of this forced outburst to break free from the shackles of heaven is devastating!
puff--! ! !
A mouthful of hot blood mixed with dark golden color and traces of filthy black air spurted out from Chu Ye's mouth like a fountain! The blood was even mixed with tiny fragments of internal organs! His eyes were instantly flooded by boundless darkness and blood! The bones all over the body let out dense explosions, as if they would break again at any time! The meridians seemed to be burned by fire, breaking every inch! The strength that had just been restored instantly receded like a tide, leaving only the severe pain that penetrated the bone marrow and extreme weakness!
